hooks.command: [ -x "${KINGPIN_ROOT:-/nonexistent}/bin/kingpin-guard" ] || { echo "kingpin: edit guard unavailable (KINGPIN_ROOT unset or kingpin-guard missing)" >&2; exit 2; }; "$KINGPIN_ROOT/bin/kingpin-guard" hook worker || exit 2

[ -n "${KINGPIN_TASK_DIR:-}" ] || exit 0; if [ -x "${KINGPIN_ROOT:-/nonexistent}/bin/kingpin-stop" ]; then "$KINGPIN_ROOT/bin/kingpin-stop" || true; else echo "kingpin: stop hook unavailable (KINGPIN_ROOT unset or kingpin-stop missing); the worker's outcome is not recorded" >&2; fi; exit 0
